# Finetuning run fails but code continues execution

## Description

I've encountered an issue with the Databricks provider in DSPy. When a finetuning run fails, the code doesn't properly handle the error condition.

Here's what happens:

1. When a finetuning job has a status of "Failed", the code sleeps for 60 seconds instead of raising an error
2. The code then continues execution as if everything is fine
3. This leads to unexpected behavior downstream, as the model deployment attempts to proceed with a failed finetuning job

## Steps to reproduce

```python
from dspy.clients.databricks import DatabricksProvider

# Configure the provider
provider = DatabricksProvider(
    host="your-databricks-host",
    token="your-token",
    cluster_id="your-cluster-id"
)

# Start a finetuning job that will fail
try:
    # This will sleep for 60 seconds when the job fails instead of raising an error
    model_name = provider.finetune(
        train_data=[{"input": "bad data"}],  # Intentionally malformed data
        model_name="databricks/model-name",
        parameters={"some_param": "value"}
    )
    
    # Code will continue here even though finetuning failed
    print(f"Got model name: {model_name}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error caught: {e}")
```

The expected behavior would be for the code to raise a ValueError when the job fails, but instead it sleeps for 60 seconds and then continues execution.

This is particularly problematic because downstream code assumes the finetuning was successful and tries to use the model, which can lead to cryptic errors or silent failures.
